description: PIN AG (Berlin, DE815837146) postage/mail receipts. PIN AG issues one Sammelrechnung (collective invoice) per delivery date, but appears to collect payment as several separate SEPA direct debits per date rather than one lump sum -- the bank history's per-date line groups sum to each invoice's Endsumme almost exactly (off by 1 cent on 2 of 8, plain rounding). Domestic German B2B invoice with real 19% USt shown per item (Steuercode 19); booked at 19% (deductible Vorsteuer), same as tl;dv. bankAmountEur is the sum of that date's bank lines (used for exact reconciliation); the invoice's own net/tax amounts are carried through, with the tax leg absorbing the 1-cent rounding difference where present. Category 'Porto'. Two of the 10 uploaded PDFs are NOT booked -- no bank line matches their date: Belegnummer 2026-001003 (2026-01-10, EUR0.88), and Belegnummer 2025-111192 (2025-10-25, EUR2.69) which is additionally billed to a different, personal address ('Moinseur Diaby, Constanze Hallgarten 46, 81379 Muenchen') rather than Media WEFILM Group UG -- likely private correspondence, not a business expense; check before booking it anywhere.
